scores.name: Retain shared full setup; wait/retry only under hourly rule
scores.reason: Keeps all existing checks but does not address demonstrated repeated last-hook timeout.

scores.name: Change only timeout numbers
scores.reason: Already 59/45; no evidence a larger value changes the observed service job budget; >59 unsupported.

scores.name: Dedicated review preparation; keep complete coding/ordinary validation
scores.reason: Removes measured redundant setup bottleneck while retaining prerequisites and all independent full acceptance gates; service selection still needs proof.

scores.name: One shared file with service/event-dependent aggregate condition
scores.reason: Needs a trusted documented discriminator; none validated here; easy to misclassify ordinary or coding sessions.

scores.name: Remove full validation from the shared setup for every consumer
scores.reason: Solves delay but unnecessarily changes the selected coding-agent full-validation contract.

scores.name: Dedicated review setup runs a named subset excluding the long hook
scores.reason: Can be honest about partial checks, but adds another test-selection contract and no needed prerequisite beyond C.

scores.name: Optimize or parallelize full SelfTest while retaining all setup work
scores.reason: Potential real benefit, but current evidence identifies a hook, not an internal optimization or safe speedup guarantee.

scores.name: Cache or snapshot dependencies and tools; retain full suite
scores.reason: Prerequisites take under a minute in these runs; does not remove 15–25min test phase; adds cache trust/invalidation.

scores.name: Purchase/configure larger hosted runner; retain full suite
scores.reason: May help CPU-bound work but hardware/bottleneck scaling is unmeasured; paid organization infrastructure is not established.

scores.name: Provision ARC self-hosted review runners
scores.reason: Supported review runner family but adds major network/ephemeral-host operations and separate infrastructure authority.

scores.name: Seek provider clarification/fix while retaining current setup
scores.reason: Useful for unexplained 20m enforcement, but no provider response or delivery date is available.

scores.name: Treat cancellation as success, skip setup, or force Lite acceptance
scores.reason: Violates current no-failing-CI rule and truthful setup/acceptance; ineligible.

limits: Observed20m annotations are not a documented universal limit.
Current service cancellation confirmed by saved root snapshot, jobs, log and explicit20m annotation; no live native query by worker.
